decision_question: How should multinational corporations adjust their China-Europe strategy in light of evolving economic relations, trade policies, and geopolitical risks?

hypotheses.hypothesis: China-Europe trade growth has decelerated since 2022 due to geopolitical tensions and EU de-risking, but absolute volumes remain high.
hypotheses.decision_relevance: Affects supply chain diversification decisions and market entry timing.
needed_evidence: Year-over-year trade volume data from 2019-2024; EU import statistics from China; sector breakdown.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Chinese FDI into Europe is shifting from traditional sectors (e.g., automotive) to high-tech and green energy, driven by China's industrial policy.
hypotheses.decision_relevance: Impacts competitive dynamics in European tech and energy sectors.
needed_evidence: FDI data by sector from China Ministry of Commerce; EU FDI screening reports; deal announcements.
search_queries: Chinese FDI in Europe 2023 sector breakdown
China Ministry of Commerce outward FDI statistics

hypotheses.hypothesis: European companies are reducing technology transfer to China due to EU export controls and IP concerns, slowing joint R&D.
hypotheses.decision_relevance: Affects innovation partnerships and licensing strategies.
needed_evidence: Survey data on technology transfer; EU export control regulations; patent filings by European firms in China.

hypotheses.hypothesis: The EU's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) will significantly increase costs for Chinese exports of steel, aluminum, and cement, altering trade patterns.
hypotheses.decision_relevance: Impacts pricing and sourcing strategies for European importers.
needed_evidence: CBAM implementation timeline; Chinese export volumes of covered goods; carbon pricing data.

hypotheses.hypothesis: China's Belt and Road Initiative (BRI) investments in Europe have plateaued, with a focus on smaller, high-return projects in Eastern Europe.
hypotheses.decision_relevance: Affects infrastructure and logistics investment opportunities.
needed_evidence: BRI project database; Chinese policy bank lending data; project completion rates.
search_queries: China Development Bank BRI lending Europe

hypotheses.hypothesis: The electric vehicle (EV) sector is becoming a flashpoint, with EU anti-subsidy investigations reducing Chinese EV market share in Europe.
hypotheses.decision_relevance: Impacts automotive OEMs and battery supply chain investments.
needed_evidence: EU anti-subsidy investigation findings; Chinese EV sales in Europe; battery import data.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Financial integration between China and Europe is deepening through currency swap agreements and increased use of RMB in trade settlements.
hypotheses.decision_relevance: Affects currency risk management and financing options.
needed_evidence: PBOC swap line data; RMB settlement volumes; SWIFT data on RMB usage.

chart_data_needs.title: EU-China Bilateral Trade Volume (2019-2024)
chart_data_needs.executive_question: How has the total trade volume between the EU and China evolved over the past six years?
comparison_set: EU imports from China vs EU exports to China, year over year
chart_data_needs.data_quality_rule: Use Eurostat as primary source; if 2024 data is incomplete, use first half annualized or IMF Direction of Trade Statistics as proxy, and mark as estimate.
chart_data_needs.narrative_role: Establishes the baseline trend of trade deceleration and resilience.
chart_data_needs.pre_exhibit_context: Before showing this chart, the report claims that trade growth has decelerated since 2022 but volumes remain high.
chart_data_needs.post_exhibit_takeaway: Trade peaked in 2022 and has since declined slightly, but remains above pre-pandemic levels, indicating deep interdependence.

chart_data_needs.title: European EV Market Share by Origin (2022-2024)
chart_data_needs.executive_question: Are Chinese electric vehicles gaining market share in Europe?
comparison_set: Market share by origin over time
chart_data_needs.data_quality_rule: Use ACEA data as primary; if 2024 not available, use EV Volumes estimates and mark as provisional.
chart_data_needs.narrative_role: Provides evidence for the EV flashpoint hypothesis and the impact of EU anti-subsidy investigations.
chart_data_needs.pre_exhibit_context: Before showing, the report claims that the EV sector is becoming a flashpoint with EU investigations.
chart_data_needs.post_exhibit_takeaway: Chinese EV market share in Europe has risen from around 3% in 2022 to an estimated 8% in 2024, despite trade barriers.

chart_data_needs.title: RMB Usage in China-Europe Trade Settlements (2019-2024)
chart_data_needs.executive_question: Is the renminbi becoming more widely used in trade settlements between China and Europe?
comparison_set: RMB vs EUR share over time
chart_data_needs.data_quality_rule: Use SWIFT data as primary; if bilateral settlement share not available, use overall RMB share in EU payments as proxy and note.
chart_data_needs.narrative_role: Demonstrates financial integration and the internationalization of the RMB.
chart_data_needs.pre_exhibit_context: Before showing, the report claims that financial integration is deepening through currency swaps and RMB usage.
chart_data_needs.post_exhibit_takeaway: RMB settlement share has grown from about 2% in 2019 to an estimated 5% in 2024, indicating gradual but steady adoption.
